title: Happiness Sustaining a Motivating Work Culture
overview: The primary goal for individuals is to achieve happiness. This course delves into strategies for enhancing workplace happiness, ultimately leading to increased motivation, productivity, and job satisfaction. Additionally, the course focuses on building essential skills that contribute to improved self-confidence and self-esteem, crucial elements for achieving success in one's career
audience: This course is designed for professional employees at various levels who seek insights into how happiness can positively impact work productivity, job satisfaction, and motivation. It is also suitable for individuals aiming to enhance their interpersonal relationships both in personal and professional contexts
methodology: This course employs various self-evaluation questionnaires to assist participants in self-discovery. Additionally, it incorporates case studies, practical team exercises, individual exercises, and roundtable discussions to enhance the learning experience
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the Science and Art of Happiness
Cultivate a Positive Attitude at Work to Strengthen Employee-Manager Relations
Enhance Work Productivity and Boost Motivation
Harness the Advantages of a Positive Work Culture
Manage Personal Anger and Elevate Personal Happiness
